Credits

The Ferrari 458 Italia model by vicent091036 was adapted for scroll animation. Material finishes and part grouping were changed. Model source and creator credit · CC BY 4.0

Studio Small 03 by Greg Zaal is used to light the scene. Poly Haven · CC0

BMW M4 Competition M Package by SRT Performance. The glTF-Transform derivative by lukaizj retains the interior and full-resolution geometry. Adapted for scroll assembly and orbit viewing. Model source · Derivative credit · CC BY 4.0

Lamborghini Aventador with Interior by BlackCube uses exterior geometry by SDC Performance and interior geometry by ultramirage10. Compressed, refinished and grouped for assembly. Model and component credits · CC BY 4.0

Bugatti Chiron exterior by Seatla Morake, provided under CC0 through Blendkit. Subdivision was applied, paint and glass materials were adapted, and parts were grouped for assembly. Exterior source · CC0

Cabin geometry by adancetegamer was extracted from the Chiron Sport asset, refinished and adapted to the replacement exterior. Cabin source · CC BY 4.0

Park grass and asphalt use aerial_grass_rock and aerial_asphalt_01 by Poly Haven, provided under CC0. Grass source · Asphalt source · CC0

Engine audio uses loop_0.wav from Racing Car Engine Sound Loops by domasx2. It is a shared recording adapted with playback speed and volume during driving. The horn is synthesized with two tones. Engine source · CC0

Desert and coastal sand use aerial_sand by Poly Haven under CC0. Sand source.

Interface icons use Lucide v0.468.0, loaded from jsDelivr with a local fallback. Lucide · ISC license.

The sharing images are renders of the interactive models. The empty studio backdrop was generated with OpenAI image generation for this independent project. This app is not affiliated with the vehicle manufacturers.

Back to Rosso / GT

Driver hand meshes from the WebXR Input Profiles Assets project under the MIT license. Posed and adapted here for steering-wheel grips.

Regional building facade atlas generated with OpenAI image generation for this project. Maps are fictional environments inspired by their regions.
